items.title: Central Matcha at Texas Farmers' Market at Mueller
items.description: Austin's Central Matcha serves whisked ceremonial-grade matcha from a market stand at the Sunday Mueller farmers market. Expect matcha shots and iced lattes made to order, plus tins and kits to take home.
items.notes: Recurring weekly slot, not a dated post: the brand site lists Mueller every Sunday and the market lists Sundays 10am-2pm. No per-week confirmation (Instagram not crawlable).

items.title: Central Matcha at Saturday farmers market (Barton Creek or Bell)
items.address: 2901 S Capital of Texas Hwy, Austin, TX 78746
items.description: Central Matcha sets up at an Austin-area Saturday farmers market, serving whisked ceremonial matcha shots and iced lattes. The brand's site says Saturdays alternate between the Barton Creek and Bell (Cedar Park) markets, so check its Instagram for which one.
items.notes: Brand lists both Barton Creek (2901 S Capital of Texas Hwy) and Texas Farmers' Market at Bell (200 S Bell Blvd, Cedar Park 78613) for Saturdays; which one on a given date is unknown. Holiday closures not checked.

items.title: Mori Matcha weekly Monday pop-up at 1 Hotel Austin
items.description: Mori Matcha, Austin's roaming matcha pop-up, is reported to set up on Mondays at the new 1 Hotel on Rainey Street. Lychee and Earl Grey matcha drinks were named in a recent review.
items.notes: TikTok snippet: 'You can find Mori at the new 1 Hotel on Rainey on Mondays, but make sure to check their IG for their pop-up schedule.' Recurring, no per-week date or hours; street number and handle not verified.
